note: A template, not a config: the placeholders name roles, never models, because model ids go stale. A host writes its own ~/.config/task-pipeline/consilium.json from its model map; consilium.py refuses to call a placeholder.
source: The operator's order of 2026-11-23: a council of six vendors' models (a decision model, a strong cheap text model, the session vendor's top model, a plan validator, a judge of an unused family, the latest model of one more vendor); the strongest model of the map rules last. Money by role (the owner, 2026-11-23): validators answer by tokens, one call each; the session's vendor sits on the subscription through --import; the strongest model thinks the spec's meanings and rules last, by tokens.

panel.model: <the map's strong cheap text model (vendor B)>
<the session's own top model, run as an agent of the session; its verdict comes in by --import p3=FILE>
panel.lens: safety, data loss and failure modes

panel.model: <a judge of a family no writer uses (vendor E)>
panel.lens: what a sceptic would attack; simpler alternatives

judge.model: <the strongest model of the host's model map on the day>

thinker.model: <the strongest model of the host's model map on the day: the spec's meanings, by tokens>
